description: This header defines the class RoomImpl, which implements the IRoom interface of the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. The class manages a chat room, including sending messages, user join/leave notifications, and callback handling.

classes.name: RoomImpl
classes.description: Implements a chat room managing user interactions, message dispatching, and callback notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the room via the room administrator interface.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Registers or unregisters a callback for user events, managing reference counting accordingly.

methods.name: UserJoined
methods.description: Handles notification that a user has joined the room, invoking the callback.

methods.name: UserLeft
methods.description: Handles notification that a user has left the room, invoking the callback.

methods.name: MessageReceived
methods.description: Forwards an incoming message from a user to a message sink if available.

methods.name: UserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this room instance.

methods.name: RoomId
methods.description: Returns the room ID associated with this room instance.
